title: unblock and unmute missing write scope check
description: interactions.rs: unblock (line 478) and unmute (line 554) do not call auth.require_scope("write"), while their counterparts block (line 406) and mute (line 517) do. Similarly, unfollow (line 265) is missing the scope check while follow (line 204) has it. These are state-mutating write operations and should require the write scope, matching the Mastodon API specification. A read-only token could currently unblock/unmute/unfollow.
